title: GM is embracing hybrids now
summary: GM eschewed hybrids in favor of battery-electric vehicles. Now it's gearing up to offer hybrid versions of its SUVs.
llm_summary: General Motors, which previously focused on pure battery‑electric models, is now turning its attention to hybrid powertrains, planning to roll out hybrid versions of its popular SUVs. This shift signals GM’s broader strategy to offer more flexible, lower‑emission options alongside its fully electric lineup.
